# The Prescription App

> > The Prescription App connects patients with independent community pharmacies across the UK for NHS prescriptions, delivery services, travel vaccines, and local healthcare.

The platform serves as a digital hub for multiple pharmacy locations including Signal Pharmacy, Frith Pharmacy, Lawsat Pharm Ltd, The Pharmacy Centre, Medicine Chest, and Church Pharmacy, primarily operating across Leicestershire, Nottinghamshire, Derbyshire, and Surrey. It enables patients to access prescription services, travel health clinics, emergency medicine, and nursing home care through a network of community pharmacies.

## Key Topics

- NHS prescriptions
- Prescription delivery
- Travel vaccines and travel clinic services
- Emergency medicine access
- Pharmacy services
- Nursing home services
- Holiday healthcare
- Community pharmacy network
- Signal Pharmacy
- The Pharmacy Centre
- Medicine Chest
- Church Pharmacy
- Frith Pharmacy
- Lawsat Pharm Ltd
- Online doctor consultations

## Pharmacy Services

- [Services | Signal Pharmacy](https://theprescriptionapp.com/signal-pharmacy/services): Signal Pharmacy services: NHS prescriptions, delivery, travel vaccines

## Pharmacy Locations

- [Frith Pharmacy](https://theprescriptionapp.com/frith-pharmacy/localshopcategories): Frith Pharmacy location in Wallington, Surrey with contact and hours
- [Lawsat Pharm Ltd](https://theprescriptionapp.com/lawsat/localshopcategories): Lawsat Pharm Ltd branches: Cliffe Woods, East Worthing, Higham, Wainscott
